label_free_vs_supervised: All results use frozen embeddings plus a supervised random forest fitted on task labels. No label-free scoring is reported.

not_mapped.reason: Bacterial promoter, human vs worm and mouse TFBS classification; no use case makes these decisions. Only the Arabidopsis rows stay on use-case-plant-promoter-reporters.
Modification-site classification of 41 bp genomic sequences; use-case-plasma-ctdna-methylation concerns tumour DNA detection from plasma methylation data, which these tasks do not measure.
Non-human epigenetic classification; outside every use case.

use_case_effects: The Supplementary Data 4 results sit on evaluations reviewed under five existing proxy judgements (use-case-rare-disease-candidate-ranking: pathogenic vs common; use-case-regulatory-variant-gene-follow-up: eQTL, sQTL, paQTL, ipaQTL). After the store write those judgements are withheld until re-pinned with npm run use-cases:repin.
reproduction: None. All values are transcribed from the paper and its supplementary workbook.
